title: Conditional acreage
message: Conditional acreage is high and comparatively stable among accepted contracts.

title: Behavioural access
message: Expected behavioural access rises with compensation.

title: Experiment-anchored mobilization
message: Prospective biomass mobilization rises steeply with compensation.

title: Rent-indexed mobilization
message: Rent parity mobilizes only a minority of prospective biomass.

title: Experimental-support exposure
message: Higher rent multipliers increasingly require extrapolation above the experimental range.

title: Unmet-biomass concentration
message: The national implementation deficit is concentrated in a small share of counties.

title: Uncertainty and sensitivity
message: Structural specification is the largest implemented source of variation.

title: Feedstock evidence coverage
message: Direct experimental support is separated from treatment-class transfer.

title: Prospective biomass allocation
message: Prospective allocation identifies where upstream biomass is located before contractual constraints.

title: Unmet prospective biomass
message: Contractual shortfall is spatially distinct from prospective resource abundance.

title: Implementation pressure
message: County contractual pressure is reported relative to the binding threshold.

title: Probability of binding
message: Bootstrap probability that contractual capacity binds.

title: Top-risk membership
message: Probability of persistent membership in the highest-risk decile.

title: Hotspot consensus
message: Robust hotspot agreement is evaluated across independent POLYSYS allocation families.
